text:
Mara K: Proposal: start a lightweight 'Action Journal' per incident to track owners, due dates, status, recurrence flag, link to postmortem, and IC-rotation note. 8-week pilot + weekly 15-min pulse. Thoughts?

Jordan L: Yes. Auto-create from postmortem close? Makes adoption easier.

Samir: Agree. Template: Incident ID, PM link, Owner @, Due date, Priority, Status, Recurrence: none/recurring/suspected, 1-line RCA, Tasks, IC flag keep/rotate.

Khalid: Prefer GH issues in a dedicated repo (assignees, labels, PR links). Add label "recurring-pattern" and reminder pings.

Rowan: IC rotation: add keep/rotate and update our monthly calendar. That avoids single-point tacit owners.

Elena: Comms cadence suggestion: T+0 incident post, T+1h update, T+24h summary + action journal link (owners/due dates/recurrence), T+72h progress, weekly pulse until closed.

ops-bot: Note: Action Journal template posted (https://go.redwood.example/action-journal-template) :bell:

Mara K: Volunteers: Jordan will create repo and GH Action to auto-create issues and ping owners; Samir will own template and weekly checklist; Khalid will add labels + recurring dashboard; Rowan will update IC calendar.

Mara K: Acceptance for pilot start next Monday: owners assigned within 48h of postmortem, >80% actions have due dates, weekly pulse scheduled. Any objections?

Jordan L: No objections.

Samir: Good to go.

Khalid: :thumbsup:

Rowan: +1

Mara K: I'll post kickoff + link tomorrow. Ping me if you want to join the pilot.
